comparison.scope: All pixels decoded and all PTS checked. Motion aesthetics are reviewed separately; timing checks alone do not establish natural motion.

contact_mechanics.coordinate_system: +X left, -Y forward, +Z up; metres; XYZ deformation rotations relative rest
contact_mechanics.contact_definition: cycle support uses the complete evaluated lower-foot skin envelope (rest Z<13cm), minimum height <= tolerance; heel/forefoot/toes landmark patch timings are separate proxies; not metadata support/IK weight
contact_mechanics.limits_are: production visual regression checks, not medical recommendations or measured forces

chosen_contact_order.Jog: forefoot no later than heel or toes; simultaneous samples allowed

contact_mechanics.kinematic_limitations: No force plate, muscle force, power or propulsion force is measured. Contact timing is quantized to 1/60s. Skin minimum is not pressure or contact area. Landmark patches intentionally leave gaps; only whole_foot defines cycle landing/support duration. Heel-raised distal-support counts require the selected forefoot/toes patches and remain a conservative anatomical proxy.

motion_curves.derivatives: cyclic forward finite differences at evaluated 60Hz poses; terminal duplicate excluded
motion_curves.limits_are: production regression thresholds, not medical ideals

authored_continuity.method: one-sided fourth-degree extrapolation of 5 points, phase steps .002/.001/.0005/.00025/.000125/.0000625/.00003125; derivative units use true cycle duration
authored_continuity.precision: best resolved difference across stencils; Blender Vector/Quaternion components are float32; support coordinates are float64. Smaller stencils resolve rapidly migrating but continuous sole contact, while larger stencils avoid float32 derivative noise
authored_continuity.note: This tests joins of authored functions, separate from finite 60Hz motion and FK/IK. Support pressure-centre sample travel is reported, not treated as skin-point slip.

contact_export.method: Regenerate bindings from Blender evaluated skinned mesh and compare with delivered analytic-author metadata; no Action or mesh edits.
